# NeuralNg Color Mode

> Optional Signal-based light/dark/system state from `@neural-ng/core/color-mode`.

## Generation rules

- Import only from `@neural-ng/core/color-mode`.
- Prefer `@neural-ng/core/appearance` when the application also needs runtime
  primary/surface palettes or direction. Never register both providers.
- Register `provideNeuralColorMode()` in application providers when the library should initialize and manage mode.
- Use `NeuralColorModeService.set('light' | 'dark' | 'system')` for changes.
- Read `preference()` for the selected preference and `resolvedMode()` for the concrete light/dark result.
- The library owns only `data-neural-mode` on `document.documentElement`.
- Keep `data-neural-theme` independent; it identifies the visual theme family.
- Do not generate an NgModule.
- Do not assume Tailwind exists and do not mutate `.dark`.
- The CSS themes work without this service when the application manages `data-neural-mode` itself.
- Use `storageKey: null` when persistence is not wanted.
- Account for first-paint mode in SSR applications with an application-owned CSP-compatible head script.

## Canonical setup

```ts
import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideNeuralColorMode } from '@neural-ng/core/color-mode';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [provideNeuralColorMode({ defaultMode: 'system' })],
};
```

```ts
import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { NeuralColorModeService } from '@neural-ng/core/color-mode';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-mode-picker',
  template: `<button type="button" (click)="mode.set('dark')">Dark</button>`,
})
export class ModePicker {
  readonly mode = inject(NeuralColorModeService);
}
```

## Tailwind v4 opt-in

```css
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@neural-ng/core/themes/neutral.css';
@import '@neural-ng/core/themes/tailwind.css';

@custom-variant dark (&:where([data-neural-mode='dark'], [data-neural-mode='dark'] *));
```

The bridge generates the full `primary-50..950` and `surface-0..950` Tailwind
color utility namespaces from NeuralNg CSS variables. It is optional and must
be processed by Tailwind CSS v4.
